name: Ki ni Naru Mekakure Shoujo wa Ao Hada Akuma de Otoko no Musume!? Nou made Ijirare Sennou Sarete Oshiri no Shojo o Ubawareru!
original_name: 気になるメカクレ少女は青肌悪魔で男の娘!?脳までいじられ洗脳されてお尻の処女を奪われる!
source:
Shinji, a down-on-his-luck guy spending his time working part-time at a convenience store while he looks for a job, had been taking a liking to a girl with a quirky sense of humor who came in every week during his shift.

He finally plucked up the courage to ask for her contact info and ask her out on a date.

But this girl’s true identity was actually that of a blue-skinned demon who preys on human men—and she was a cross-dressing guy with a penis…!
